VI.description: Drives an open LabVIEW menu with one key\3A posts WM_KEYDOWN and WM_KEYUP of vk (lParam key lParam\2C plus the previous-state and transition bits 0xC0000000 for the key-up) to hWnd - the served panel\2C which holds the mouse capture while a LabVIEW menu is open - with user32 PostMessageW\2C then waits until the popups differ from popup hWnds (RemoteVI Wait Popups Change.vi\2C at most 300 ms). Used by RemoteVI Post Input.vi to close a submenu (VK_LEFT) and to open the highlighted item's submenu (VK_RIGHT)\3A LabVIEW menus take posted keys also while a submenu is open (measured). Win32 only\2C no VI Server call\2C so it runs while the menu's modal loop holds LabVIEW's UI thread. An incoming error posts nothing.

FreeLabel.comment: Key down, key up, wait for the menus

Control.description: lParam of the key-down\3A repeat count 1\2C the scan code in bits 16-23\2C bit 24 for an extended key.
The popups open before the key\3B the wait ends when one of them closes or a new menu window appears.

Call.inputs: panel hWnd:hw.value,popup hWnds:ph.value,timeout ms:tmo.value,error in:pu.error out

Indicator.description: TRUE when the popups changed within 300 ms.
error in or a PostMessageW error.
